description: How robots acquire skills from demonstrations, rewards and models, and how those skills are made to work on real hardware safely. Students implement imitation, policy-gradient and model-based learning in small simulated tasks, train perception for grasping, test sim-to-real transfer, and evaluate policies with proper statistics.
modelledOn: Sutton and Barto, Reinforcement Learning: An Introduction
Siciliano and Khatib (eds.), Springer Handbook of Robotics
Kober, Bagnell and Peters, Reinforcement Learning in Robotics: A Survey
Published lecture notes and survey papers on deep reinforcement learning and imitation learning for robotics
outcomes: Formulate a robot task as a Markov decision process with states, actions, rewards and a data budget.
Implement behavioural cloning, DAgger and a policy-gradient method and explain their failure modes.
Learn dynamics models and plan with them using model predictive control, and relate model error to performance.
Train visual models for grasping and visuomotor control and assess their robustness.
Design sim-to-real transfer with randomisation and system identification, and add safety constraints to learning.
Evaluate robot policies with statistically sound protocols and report successes, failures and costs honestly.

units.title: Foundations of robot learning
topics: The robot learning problem: sensing, acting, MDPs and POMDPs
Kinematics, dynamics and configuration space in brief
Data in robotics: demonstrations, rollouts, datasets and the cost of real-world data
Reinforcement learning recap: value functions, Bellman equations, temporal difference learning and Q-learning

units.title: Imitation learning
topics: Behavioural cloning and covariate shift
DAgger and interactive imitation learning
Inverse reinforcement learning and maximum-entropy IRL
Adversarial imitation learning (GAIL)
Learning from teleoperation and video; action chunking and diffusion policies
Dynamic movement primitives

units.title: Policy gradient methods
topics: REINFORCE, baselines and variance reduction
Actor-critic methods and generalised advantage estimation
Trust-region methods: TRPO and PPO
Off-policy continuous control: DDPG, TD3 and SAC
Reward design, shaping, sparse rewards, curricula and exploration

units.title: Model-based reinforcement learning
topics: Learning dynamics models: deterministic and probabilistic ensembles
Planning with models: model predictive control, cross-entropy method and MPPI
Dyna-style methods and model-based policy optimisation
Latent world models, compounding error and model bias
Links to optimal control: LQR and iterative LQR

units.title: Deep perception for manipulation
topics: Visual features: convolutional and transformer encoders, pretrained representations
Object pose, keypoints and grasp detection
End-to-end visuomotor policies
Depth, point clouds and tactile sensing
Language-conditioned and vision-language-action policies

units.title: Sim-to-real transfer
topics: Physics simulators and the reality gap
Domain randomisation of dynamics, visuals and sensors
System identification, domain adaptation and real-to-sim
Residual policies and fine-tuning on hardware
Low-cost and open-source arms and mobile robots for local labs

units.title: Safe learning
topics: Constrained MDPs and Lagrangian methods
Safe exploration, control barrier functions and shielding
Uncertainty estimation: ensembles, Bayesian methods and conformal prediction
Human oversight, emergency stops, failure modes and safety standards

units.title: Evaluation on real robots
topics: Metrics: success rate, confidence intervals and sample efficiency
Experimental protocols: randomised initial conditions, seeds and blind trials
Benchmarks, reproducibility and reporting failures
Generalisation tests and distribution shift
Costs: data collection, compute budgets and hardware wear

units.title: Project
topics: Problem selection and baselines
Training and evaluation pipeline
Write-up: results, ablations and limitations
Project presentation and critique

schedule.title: Foundations of robot learning
schedule.exercise: Formulate a pick-and-place task as an MDP, list its observations, actions and reward, and estimate how many real trials a learning approach would need.

tasks.title: Run Q-learning on a small grid world, step through the value updates, and show how the learned policy changes with discount and learning rate
Compute forward kinematics of a 2-link arm with matrices, solve inverse kinematics for 5 targets, and plot the reachable workspace
Define a gym-style environment for a 2-link arm reaching a target, with reward and termination, and test a random policy for 100 episodes

schedule.title: Behavioural cloning and interactive imitation
schedule.exercise: Explain why a cloned policy drifts away from the demonstrations, and show how DAgger corrects it with expert relabelling.

tasks.title: Clone a policy from 20 demonstrations in a driving grid task and watch the errors accumulate along a rollout
Implement DAgger for a lane-following task, run 5 iterations, and compare success rate and expert queries with plain cloning
Recover a reward function from 30 expert trajectories on a grid world using maximum-entropy IRL and test it on a new layout

schedule.title: Adversarial imitation, demonstrations and primitives
schedule.exercise: Compare imitation from teleoperation with learning from video, and fit a movement primitive to a demonstrated reach.

tasks.title: Fit a dynamic movement primitive to a demonstrated reach, change the goal and duration, and plot the generalised trajectories
Train a small GAIL agent on a 2D navigation task and compare its returns with behavioural cloning for 10, 50 and 200 demonstrations
Train a policy that predicts chunks of 8 future actions from demonstrations of a pushing task and compare it with single-step prediction

schedule.title: Policy gradients and actor-critic
schedule.exercise: Derive the policy gradient estimator, show how a baseline reduces variance, and describe the clipping in PPO.

tasks.title: Implement REINFORCE on a cart-pole task, plot learning curves with and without a baseline over 10 seeds, and compare their variance
Step through an actor-critic update on a short rollout, showing the value estimate, advantage and policy parameter change at each step
Implement PPO with a clipped objective on a reaching task and sweep the clip range to find where training becomes unstable

schedule.title: Off-policy methods and reward design
schedule.exercise: Choose between on-policy and off-policy learning for a real arm with a limited trial budget, and design a shaped reward that avoids exploits.

tasks.title: Train SAC on a pendulum swing-up task and compare sample efficiency with PPO over 5 seeds
Write a sparse and a shaped reward for a block-pushing task, train with each, and report the exploit that the shaped reward invites
Build a curriculum that increases the target distance over training in a reaching task and compare it with training on the hardest case

schedule.title: Learning dynamics models
schedule.exercise: Explain how an ensemble separates model uncertainty from noise, and describe the receding-horizon loop of model predictive control.

tasks.title: Fit a neural dynamics model on 5,000 transitions of a pendulum and plot one-step and 20-step prediction error
Plan with the cross-entropy method over the learned model for a reaching task and compare the success rate with a random shooting planner
Implement a Dyna-style loop that mixes real and model rollouts, and plot return against real environment steps against model-free SAC

schedule.title: World models and optimal control
schedule.exercise: Show how model errors compound over a long rollout, and derive the LQR solution for a linearised pendulum.

tasks.title: Compute the LQR gain for a linearised cart-pole using matrices, simulate the closed loop from a small perturbation, and plot the state
Roll a learned model and the true system forward from the same state, plot the divergence, and find the horizon beyond which the model misleads
Train a small latent dynamics model from images of a pushing task and plan in latent space, then report failures caused by model error

schedule.title: Perception for manipulation
schedule.exercise: Compare end-to-end visuomotor control with a perceive-then-plan pipeline for grasping, and discuss when language conditioning helps.

tasks.title: Step a small convolutional network over an image of objects and see the activations and the predicted grasp point and angle
Train a grasp success classifier on 2,000 labelled grasp crops, plot precision against recall, and choose a threshold for a gripper that must rarely drop items
Train a visuomotor policy on rendered images with spatial softmax keypoints and compare it with a pretrained feature encoder on held-out scenes

schedule.title: The reality gap and domain randomisation
schedule.exercise: List the sources of the reality gap for a wheeled robot, and choose randomisation ranges that cover reality without making the task impossible.

tasks.title: Simulate a mobile robot with two friction values and compare the same controller trajectories to identify which parameters drive the gap
Train a reaching policy with narrow and wide randomisation of mass and friction and test both on a held-out perturbed simulator
Run a policy trained in simulation on a small servo arm or wheeled board, log the tracking error, and list which randomised parameter was missing

schedule.title: System identification, adaptation and low-cost hardware
schedule.exercise: Fit unknown physical parameters from logged data, then fine-tune a policy with residual correction on hardware.

tasks.title: Estimate mass and damping of a simulated mass-spring system from noisy logs by least squares and compare predicted and observed motion
Add a residual policy on top of a fixed controller, train it on perturbed dynamics, and show tracking error with and without the residual
Build a pan-tilt camera with two servos and a Raspberry Pi, train it to centre a target with learned control, and measure its error

schedule.title: Safe learning
schedule.exercise: Write a constrained MDP for a delivery robot near people, add a safety filter, and describe how uncertainty triggers a stop.

tasks.title: Train a policy with a Lagrangian cost constraint on a navigation task and plot return against constraint violations as the limit is tightened
Add a shield that blocks unsafe actions in a grid navigation task, step through where it intervenes, and report the effect on reward
Use an ensemble of policies to estimate uncertainty on test states, and stop the robot above a threshold, reporting missed and false stops

schedule.title: Evaluating robot policies
schedule.exercise: Plan a trial protocol for comparing two grasping policies on a real arm with 50 trials each, and report intervals, failures and costs.

tasks.title: Compute success rates with 95 percent confidence intervals for two policies over 50 trials each and decide if the difference is significant
Design a randomised initial condition schedule for 40 trials, run it against two policies in simulation, and detect order effects
Test a trained policy on shifted lighting, object sizes and friction, and plot success against the size of each shift

schedule.title: Project
schedule.exercise: Present a robot learning project with baseline, method, evaluation protocol, ablation and an honest list of failure cases.

tasks.title: Implement a baseline controller and a learned policy for your chosen task and report the baseline's success rate over 100 episodes
Run an ablation removing one component of your method, with 5 seeds each, and plot the results with confidence intervals
Replay 5 failed rollouts in the visualiser, classify the cause of each failure, and propose a fix for the most common cause
